name: Eczema Honey
description: US skincare brand for eczema-prone and sensitive skin, built around 1% colloidal oatmeal formulas (Original Skin-Soothing Cream, oatmeal body lotion and hand cream) carrying the National Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance, sold via eczemahoneyco.com.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Partnerships page (fetched 2026-11-21) runs an open partner program via UpPromote ('Apply to Partner', free to join, ~2-minute form): partners earn 15% on each referred new customer's first order and 10% on repeat orders, with a 30-day cookie, monthly PayPal payouts and a personal code giving the audience 10% off; selected creators may receive free product. The page publishes no earnings-cap statement and no creator count, so cap and saturation are recorded unknown.

The partnerships page confirms the brand sells eczema-focused skincare (Original Skin-Soothing Cream, Oatmeal Body Lotion, Oatmeal Hand Cream) direct to consumers and markets to parents, eczema support groups, bloggers and creators.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure sensitive-skin / eczema skincare — squarely in the skincare niche, with a parent-and-family creator angle.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits customers, parents, creators and bloggers as partners, with disclosure hashtags and content guidance published.
reasons.compensation: First-party published rates: 15% on a referred new customer's first order and 10% on repeat orders, 30-day cookie, monthly PayPal payouts. No cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Public application route on the brand's own partnerships page; applications are reviewed and answered by email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open now — free to join with a short application form.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC brand whose hero products carry the National Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance.

name: Tiege Hanley
description: US men's skincare brand selling simple, system-based skincare routines for men by subscription and one-time purchase via tiege.com, with additional creator channels on Amazon, TikTok Shop and the Shop app.

evidence.summary: Tiege Hanley's own Refersion program agreement (fetched 2026-11-21) confirms an open affiliate program: commission is a percentage of the purchase price (excluding tax and shipping) on a referred customer's first purchase within 14 days of clicking the affiliate link, plus a $50 content usage payment the first time the brand uses a creator's content in paid usage. The percentage itself is set in the program description rather than the agreement. The agreement states no earnings cap and no creator count, so cap and saturation are recorded unknown.

Third-party sources conflict on the rate: a getsaral case study reports affiliates earning 20% commission, while Lasso's directory lists 'up to 15%'. Because the brand's own program materials do not publish a single rate, commission_rate is recorded null.

reasons.niche_fit: Men's skincare is a growing creator niche and Tiege Hanley is one of its anchor DTC brands.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program terms build in paid content usage ($50 first paid use) and the brand also runs TikTok Shop and Shop app creator channels, per its own affiliate page.
reasons.compensation: Rate not recorded: third-party sources conflict (20% in a case study vs up to 15% in a directory) and the brand's own terms set the percentage privately. No cap statement published — cap unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Public Refersion application portal plus a dedicated affiliate page on the brand's own site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Refersion, subject to brand approval.
reasons.credibility: Established US men's skincare company selling DTC since 2016 with national name recognition.

name: FRÉ Skincare
description: Skincare brand operated by FRÉ Skincare Ltd. selling targeted facial skincare products direct to consumers via freskincare.com, with an affiliate program built around monthly Instagram content from its affiliates.

evidence.summary: FRÉ Skincare's own Refersion affiliate agreement (fetched 2026-11-21) confirms an open affiliate program run by FRÉ Skincare Ltd.: commission is a fixed percentage of net receipts on qualified purchases, paid monthly by wire, check or PayPal. The percentage is conveyed to affiliates in writing rather than published, and affiliates must post about the brand on Instagram at least once a month, with the brand retaining perpetual rights to affiliate content. The agreement states no earnings cap and no creator count, so the rate is recorded null and cap and saturation unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Facial skincare sold DTC — in-niche, with an active-lifestyle angle that suits fitness-beauty crossover creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is built around creator content: affiliates must post on Instagram monthly and the brand licenses affiliate content for its own channels in perpetuity.
reasons.compensation: Commission is a percentage of net receipts paid monthly, but the percentage is not published (conveyed privately to accepted affiliates), so the rate is recorded null. No cap statement published — cap unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Public Refersion application portal run by the brand itself.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, but acceptance is at the brand's sole discretion and rejected applicants may not re-apply without consent.
reasons.credibility: Operating DTC skincare brand (FRÉ Skincare Ltd.) with a formal, published affiliate agreement.
